body:
Reviewed PR #1 (rheos): eta-mu workflow gate gating, source-preserving YAML frontmatter edits, and refusal propagation — 43 files, all 62 diff pages read and assessed.

**Deterministic evidence:** 10/10 CI-equivalent gates pass at the exact head SHA; full suite green (218 tests, 1915 assertions, 0 failures). Install was done with `--no-lockfile` (no pnpm-lock.yaml exists in the repo), noted as an environment caveat rather than a change defect.

**What was verified:** load-refusal contract end-to-end (task_store → compose → CLI exit 3 with `source-path` / HTTP 500 with identical message / MCP isError); refusals fire before every side effect in task_create and task_edit (register-event/write/emit ordering pinned by tests); the descending-sort value patch retains anchors, BOMs, block separators, closing delimiters and trailing newlines — every suspicious branch (empty values, mixed line endings, anchored scalars, retained `!!` tags, cyclic aliases) is pinned by green tests at this head; the workflow gate script fails closed on non-draft runs and cannot hide tracked mutations.

**Confirmed findings:** none. Two low-severity candidates were registered and adversarially rejected: (1) a collection-valued core-field update surfaces as HTTP 500 rather than 400 — the catch-all is pre-existing, the documented message contract holds, and it strictly improves on base behavior which returned 200 after writing corrupt frontmatter; (2) a race-only path (external edit between load and edit) can exit 4 instead of 3 — no stable trace exists since load and edit run identical validation, and the exit-3 documentation is explicitly read/load-scoped.

**Non-blocking notes (summary-only test gaps):** the workflow script's `skip` branches (`skip_gates`, draft handling) are not covered by tests; `law/frontmatter.cljc`'s `assert-title-shape` and `extern/yaml.cljs`'s `finite-number?` are unused by production call sites; fork/draft job skipping is policy (drafts re-run on `ready_for_review`, fail-closed elsewhere) and the external reusable workflow is not inspectable from this diff.
